test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Ostacise.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Incorrectly spelt word is Ostacise.
 
• The correctly spelt word is** 'Ostracize'. **
 
• It means 'to refuse to allow somebody to be a member of a social group' (किसी को सामाजिक समूह का सदस्य बनने की अनुमति देने से इंकार करना')
 
 
• Example - He was ostracized by his colleagues for refusing to support the strike.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Impoverish **means **make (a person or area) poor,**
 
• **Necessitate **means **make (something) necessary as a result or consequence.**
 
• **Grandeur ** means **splendour and impressiveness, especially of appearance or style.**
